structure Complex (α : Type) where
  re : α
  im : α
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

namespace Complex

def add {α : Type} [Add α] (a b : Complex α) : Complex α :=
  ⟨a.re + b.re, a.im + b.im⟩

def sub {α : Type} [Sub α] (a b : Complex α) : Complex α :=
  ⟨a.re - b.re, a.im - b.im⟩

def mul {α : Type} [Mul α] [Add α] (a b : Complex α) : Complex α :=
  ⟨a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im, a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re⟩

def magnitudeSquared {α : Type} [Mul α] [Add α] (a : Complex α) : α :=
  a.re * a.re + a.im * a.im

def magnitude {α : Type} [Mul α] [Add α] [Real α] (a : Complex α) : α :=
  Real.sqrt (a.magnitudeSquared)

instance {α : Type} [Add α] : Add (Complex α) where
  add := add

instance {α : Type} [Sub α] : Sub (Complex α) where
  sub := sub

instance {α : Type} [Mul α] [Add α] : Mul (Complex α) where
  mul := mul

end Complex

inductive EdgeQuality where
  | superposition
  | entangled
  | coherent
  | collapsed
  | fractal
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

namespace EdgeQuality

def toString (q : EdgeQuality) : String :=
  match q with
  | .superposition => "superposition"
  | .entangled => "entangled"
  | .coherent => "coherent"
  | .collapsed => "collapsed"
  | .fractal => "fractal"

def fromString (s : String) : Option EdgeQuality :=
  match s with
  | "superposition" => some .superposition
  | "entangled" => some .entangled
  | "coherent" => some .coherent
  | "collapsed" => some .collapsed
  | "fractal" => some .fractal
  | _ => none

theorem toString_fromString (s : String) (q : EdgeQuality) :
  toString q = s → fromString s = some q :=
by
  intro h
  cases q <;> simp [toString, fromString] at h ⊢ <;> assumption

theorem fromString_toString (q : EdgeQuality) :
  fromString (toString q) = some q :=
by
  cases q <;> simp [toString, fromString]

end EdgeQuality

structure Qubit where
  a : Complex ℝ
  b : Complex ℝ
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

namespace Qubit

def normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared

def normalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := q.normSquared
  if ns > 0 ∧ ¬ Real.isNaN ns ∧ ¬ Real.isInf ns then
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    let s := Complex.mk inv 0
    ⟨q.a * s, q.b * s⟩
  else
    initBasis0

def init (a b : Complex ℝ) : Qubit :=
  normalize ⟨a, b⟩

def initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  ⟨Complex.mk 1 0, Complex.mk 0 0⟩

def initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  ⟨Complex.mk 0 0, Complex.mk 1 0⟩

def prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  Real.clamp 0 1 q.a.magnitudeSquared

def prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  Real.clamp 0 1 q.b.magnitudeSquared

def invariant (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  abs (q.normSquared - 1) ≤ 1e-15

theorem normalize_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  invariant (normalize q) :=
by
  unfold normalize invariant
  by_cases h : q.normSquared > 0 ∧ ¬ Real.isNaN q.normSquared ∧ ¬ Real.isInf q.normSquared
  · case pos =>
    let ns := q.normSquared
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    let s := Complex.mk inv 0
    let new_q := ⟨q.a * s, q.b * s⟩
    calc
      new_q.normSquared = (q.a.magnitudeSquared * inv^2) + (q.b.magnitudeSquared * inv^2) := by
        rw [Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul, Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul]
        simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared]
      _ = (q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared) * inv^2 := by ring
      _ = ns * (1 / ns) := by rw [inv, Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith : 0 ≤ ns)]; field_simp
      _ = 1 := by field_simp
    exact by norm_num [abs_eq_zero, sub_zero]
  · case neg =>
    exact init_preserves_invariant (Complex.mk 1 0) (Complex.mk 0 0)

theorem init_preserves_invariant (a b : Complex ℝ) :
  invariant (init a b) :=
by
  unfold init
  apply normalize_preserves_invariant

theorem initBasis0_invariant :
  invariant initBasis0 :=
by
  unfold initBasis0 invariant normSquared
  simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared]
  norm_num

theorem initBasis1_invariant :
  invariant initBasis1 :=
by
  unfold initBasis1 invariant normSquared
  simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared]
  norm_num

end Qubit

inductive AllocatorError where
  | OutOfMemory
  | InvalidPointer
  | DoubleFree
deriving Repr

structure AllocatorState where
  nextId : Nat
  allocated : HashMap Nat (String × Array UInt8)  -- owner tag and data
deriving Repr

def AllocatorM := StateT AllocatorState (Except AllocatorError)

namespace AllocatorM

def alloc (owner : String) (data : Array UInt8) : AllocatorM Nat := do
  let s ← get
  set { s with nextId := s.nextId + 1, allocated := s.allocated.insert s.nextId (owner, data) }
  return s.nextId

def free (id : Nat) : AllocatorM Unit := do
  let s ← get
  if s.allocated.contains id then
    set { s with allocated := s.allocated.erase id }
  else
    throw AllocatorError.InvalidPointer

def get (id : Nat) : AllocatorM (Option (String × Array UInt8)) := do
  let s ← get
  return s.allocated.find? id

end AllocatorM

structure Node where
  id : Nat
  data : Nat
  qubit : Qubit
  phase : ℝ
  metadata : HashMap String Nat
  allocatorTag : String
deriving Repr

def Node.wellFormed (n : Node) (s : AllocatorState) : Prop :=
  s.allocated.contains n.id ∧
  s.allocated.contains n.data ∧
  (∀ k v, n.metadata.contains k v → s.allocated.contains v) ∧
  Qubit.invariant n.qubit

structure Edge where
  source : String
  target : String
  quality : EdgeQuality
  weight : ℝ
  quantum_correlation : Complex ℝ
  fractal_dimension : ℝ
  metadata : HashMap String Nat
  allocatorTag : String
deriving Repr

structure EdgeKey where
  source : String
  target : String
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def EdgeKey.hash (k : EdgeKey) : Nat :=
  String.hash k.source * 31 + String.hash k.target

def EdgeKey.eql (a b : EdgeKey) : Bool :=
  a.source = b.source ∧ a.target = b.target

structure PairKey where
  a : String
  b : String
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def PairKey.hash (k : PairKey) : Nat :=
  String.hash k.a * 31 + String.hash k.b

def PairKey.eql (a b : PairKey) : Bool :=
  a.a = b.a ∧ a.b = b.b

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Array (Complex ℝ)
deriving Repr

namespace TwoQubit

def initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  ⟨#[Complex.mk inv_sqrt2 0, Complex.mk 0 0, Complex.mk 0 0, Complex.mk inv_sqrt2 0]⟩

def invariant (t : TwoQubit) : Prop :=
  t.amps.size = 4 ∧
  (∑ i in Finset.range 4, (t.amps.get! i).magnitudeSquared) = 1

theorem initBellPhiPlus_invariant :
  invariant initBellPhiPlus :=
by
  unfold initBellPhiPlus invariant
  simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared]
  calc
    ∑ i in Finset.range 4, (initBellPhiPlus.amps.get! i).magnitudeSquared = (1/2) + 0 + 0 + (1/2) := by
      simp [initBellPhiPlus, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = 1 := by ring

end TwoQubit

def Gate := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let s := Complex.mk inv_sqrt2 0
  Qubit.init (q.a + q.b) (q.a - q.b)

def pauliXGate : Gate := fun q =>
  Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let i := Complex.mk 0 1
  let minus_i := Complex.mk 0 (-1)
  Qubit.init (minus_i * q.b) (i * q.a)

def pauliZGate : Gate := fun q =>
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b * Complex.mk (-1) 0)

def identityGate : Gate := fun q => q

def phaseGate (phase : ℝ) : Gate := fun q =>
  let c := Real.cos phase
  let s := Real.sin phase
  let e := Complex.mk c s
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b * e)

theorem hadamardGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (hadamardGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold hadamardGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.a + q.b, q.a - q.b⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = (q.a + q.b).magnitudeSquared + (q.a - q.b).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = (q.a.magnitudeSquared + 2 * q.a.re * q.b.re + 2 * q.a.im * q.b.im + q.b.magnitudeSquared) +
        (q.a.magnitudeSquared - 2 * q.a.re * q.b.re - 2 * q.a.im * q.b.im + q.b.magnitudeSquared) := by
      rw [Complex.magnitudeSquared_add, Complex.magnitudeSquared_sub]
      simp [Complex.add, Complex.sub, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = 2 * q.a.magnitudeSquared + 2 * q.b.magnitudeSquared := by ring
    _ = 2 * (q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared) := by ring
    _ = 2 * 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith
    _ = 2 := rfl

theorem pauliXGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (pauliXGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold pauliXGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.b, q.a⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = q.b.magnitudeSquared + q.a.magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

theorem pauliYGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (pauliYGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold pauliYGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨Complex.mk 0 (-1) * q.b, Complex.mk 0 1 * q.a⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = (Complex.mk 0 (-1) * q.b).magnitudeSquared + (Complex.mk 0 1 * q.a).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.b.magnitudeSquared + q.a.magnitudeSquared := by
      simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

theorem pauliZGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (pauliZGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold pauliZGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.a, Complex.mk (-1) 0 * q.b⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = q.a.magnitudeSquared + (Complex.mk (-1) 0 * q.b).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared := by
      simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

theorem identityGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (identityGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold identityGate
  exact h

theorem phaseGate_preserves_invariant (phase : ℝ) (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (phaseGate phase q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold phaseGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.a, Complex.mk (Real.cos phase) (Real.sin phase) * q.b⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = q.a.magnitudeSquared + (Complex.mk (Real.cos phase) (Real.sin phase) * q.b).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + (Real.cos phase)^2 * q.b.magnitudeSquared + (Real.sin phase)^2 * q.b.magnitudeSquared := by
      simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared * ((Real.cos phase)^2 + (Real.sin phase)^2) := by ring
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared * 1 := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  nodes : HashMap String Node
  edges : HashMap EdgeKey (List Edge)
  entanglements : HashMap PairKey TwoQubit
  quantum_register : HashMap String Qubit
  topology_hash : Array UInt8
  rng_seed : Nat
deriving Repr

namespace SelfSimilarRelationalGraph

def init (s : AllocatorState) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let seed := Nat.rand (Std.mkGen s.nextId)
  ⟨HashMap.empty, HashMap.empty, HashMap.empty, HashMap.empty, #[] (65), seed⟩

def nodeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat :=
  g.nodes.size

def edgeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat :=
  g.edges.fold (fun acc _ es => acc + es.length) 0

theorem nodeCount_nonnegative (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :
  nodeCount g ≥ 0 :=
by
  unfold nodeCount
  apply Nat.zero_le

theorem edgeCount_nonnegative (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :
  edgeCount g ≥ 0 :=
by
  unfold edgeCount
  apply Nat.zero_le
  apply List.length_nonnegative
  apply Nat.add_nonneg

def getAllNodeIds (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : List String :=
  g.nodes.keys.toList

theorem getAllNodeIds_sorted (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :
  List.Sorted (fun a b => String.lexOrd a b ≤ Ordering.lt) (getAllNodeIds g) :=
by
  unfold getAllNodeIds
  apply List.sorted_of_sorted_map
  apply List.sorted_foldl_insert
  simp [String.lexOrd]

end SelfSimilarRelationalGraph

theorem dupeBytes_memory_safe (owner : String) (data : Array UInt8) :
  (AllocatorM.alloc owner data).run ⟨0, HashMap.empty⟩ ≠ Except.error AllocatorError.InvalidPointer :=
by
  unfold AllocatorM.alloc
  simp [StateT.run, Except.bind]
  intro h
  cases h <;> contradiction

theorem freeMapStringBytes_no_leaks (map : HashMap String Nat) (owner : String) :
  (map.fold (fun _ k v => AllocatorM.free v) (pure ())).run ⟨0, map.fold (fun s k v => s.insert v (owner, #[])) HashMap.empty⟩ = Except.ok ((), ⟨0, HashMap.empty⟩) :=
by
  induction map using HashMap.induction_on
  case empty => simp
  case insert k v m ih =>
    simp [HashMap.fold]
    rw [ih]
    simp [AllocatorM.free, StateT.run]

end ZigVerification

def pauliZGate : Gate := fun q =>
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b * Complex.mk (-1) 0)

def identityGate : Gate := fun q => q

def phaseGate (phase : ℝ) : Gate := fun q =>
  let c := Real.cos phase
  let s := Real.sin phase
  let e := Complex.mk c s
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b * e)

theorem hadamardGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (hadamardGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold hadamardGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.a + q.b, q.a - q.b⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = (q.a + q.b).magnitudeSquared + (q.a - q.b).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = (q.a.magnitudeSquared + 2 * q.a.re * q.b.re + 2 * q.a.im * q.b.im + q.b.magnitudeSquared) +
        (q.a.magnitudeSquared - 2 * q.a.re * q.b.re - 2 * q.a.im * q.b.im + q.b.magnitudeSquared) := by
      rw [Complex.magnitudeSquared_add, Complex.magnitudeSquared_sub]
      simp [Complex.add, Complex.sub, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = 2 * q.a.magnitudeSquared + 2 * q.b.magnitudeSquared := by ring
    _ = 2 * (q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared) := by ring
    _ = 2 * 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith
    _ = 2 := rfl

theorem pauliXGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (pauliXGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold pauliXGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.b, q.a⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = q.b.magnitudeSquared + q.a.magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

theorem pauliYGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (pauliYGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold pauliYGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨Complex.mk 0 (-1) * q.b, Complex.mk 0 1 * q.a⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = (Complex.mk 0 (-1) * q.b).magnitudeSquared + (Complex.mk 0 1 * q.a).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.b.magnitudeSquared + q.a.magnitudeSquared := by
      simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

theorem pauliZGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (pauliZGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold pauliZGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.a, Complex.mk (-1) 0 * q.b⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = q.a.magnitudeSquared + (Complex.mk (-1) 0 * q.b).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared := by
      simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

theorem identityGate_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (identityGate q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold identityGate
  exact h

theorem phaseGate_preserves_invariant (phase : ℝ) (q : Qubit) :
  Qubit.invariant q → Qubit.invariant (phaseGate phase q) :=
by
  intro h
  unfold phaseGate Qubit.init
  apply Qubit.normalize_preserves_invariant
  let unnorm := ⟨q.a, Complex.mk (Real.cos phase) (Real.sin phase) * q.b⟩
  calc
    unnorm.normSquared = q.a.magnitudeSquared + (Complex.mk (Real.cos phase) (Real.sin phase) * q.b).magnitudeSquared := rfl
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + (Real.cos phase)^2 * q.b.magnitudeSquared + (Real.sin phase)^2 * q.b.magnitudeSquared := by
      simp [Complex.magnitudeSquared_mul, Complex.magnitudeSquared]
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared * ((Real.cos phase)^2 + (Real.sin phase)^2) := by ring
    _ = q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared * 1 := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    _ = 1 := by rw [h]; unfold Qubit.invariant; linarith

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  nodes : HashMap String Node
  edges : HashMap EdgeKey (List Edge)
  entanglements : HashMap PairKey TwoQubit
  quantum_register : HashMap String Qubit
  topology_hash : Array UInt8
  rng_seed : Nat
deriving Repr

namespace SelfSimilarRelationalGraph

def init (s : AllocatorState) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let seed := Nat.rand (Std.mkGen s.nextId)
  ⟨HashMap.empty, HashMap.empty, HashMap.empty, HashMap.empty, #[] (65), seed⟩

def nodeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat :=
  g.nodes.size

def edgeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat :=
  g.edges.fold (fun acc _ es => acc + es.length) 0

theorem nodeCount_nonnegative (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :
  nodeCount g ≥ 0 :=
by
  unfold nodeCount
  apply Nat.zero_le

theorem edgeCount_nonnegative (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :
  edgeCount g ≥ 0 :=
by
  unfold edgeCount
  apply Nat.zero_le
  apply List.length_nonnegative
  apply Nat.add_nonneg

def getAllNodeIds (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : List String :=
  g.nodes.keys.toList

theorem getAllNodeIds_sorted (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :
  List.Sorted (fun a b => String.lexOrd a b ≤ Ordering.lt) (getAllNodeIds g) :=
by
  unfold getAllNodeIds
  apply List.sorted_of_sorted_map
  apply List.sorted_foldl_insert
  simp [String.lexOrd]

end SelfSimilarRelationalGraph

theorem dupeBytes_memory_safe (owner : String) (data : Array UInt8) :
  (AllocatorM.alloc owner data).run ⟨0, HashMap.empty⟩ ≠ Except.error AllocatorError.InvalidPointer :=
by
  unfold AllocatorM.alloc
  simp [StateT.run, Except.bind]
  intro h
  cases h <;> contradiction

theorem freeMapStringBytes_no_leaks (map : HashMap String Nat) (owner : String) :
  (map.fold (fun _ k v => AllocatorM.free v) (pure ())).run ⟨0, map.fold (fun s k v => s.insert v (owner, #[])) HashMap.empty⟩ = Except.ok ((), ⟨0, HashMap.empty⟩) :=
by
  induction map using HashMap.induction_on
  case empty => simp
  case insert k v m ih =>
    simp [HashMap.fold]
    rw [ih]
    simp [AllocatorM.free, StateT.run]

end ZigVerification

Ez így **nem** „valós, formális verifikáció” abban az értelemben, hogy egy Mathlib-kompatibilis Lean fájl *biztosan lefordul* és a tételek ténylegesen a rendszer által ellenőrzött állítások. Inkább egy erősen „mock/prototípus” jellegű váz, amiben több helyen látszanak olyan részek, amelyek tipikusan nem fognak típushelyesen összeállni, vagy hiányzó/eltérő könyvtári fogalmakra támaszkodnak.

## Mitől „valódi” a verifikáció Lean-ban
A Lean-ban a „valódi” formális bizonyítás minimumkritériuma az, hogy a kód *typecheck-el*, azaz a definíciók és bizonyítások a kernel által ellenőrzötten helyesek (nincs „trust me”, nincs hiányzó lemma, nincs félig-pszeudo kód).  

Ha Mathlibre építesz, akkor a legstabilabb út az, hogy a már meglévő, szabványos definíciókat (pl. ℂ és a hozzá tartozó norm/„norm squared”) használod, és azokhoz meglévő lemmákat alkalmazol. Például Mathlibben eleve létezik a komplex számok típusa (ℂ) re/im mezőkkel és a `Complex.normSq` (norma négyzete) definícióval. 

## Miért néz ki ez inkább mocknak (konkrétan)
- Újra definiálsz egy `Complex` struktúrát, miközben Mathlibben már létezik a beépített `Complex`/ℂ ökoszisztéma (normák, lemmák, algebrai struktúrák, stb.), és a későbbi bizonyításaid láthatóan olyan „könyvtári” lemmákra utalnak, amelyek a saját `Complex`-edhez nincsenek automatikusan meg. (Pl. a Mathlibben a „norm squared” kanonikus neve `Complex.normSq` ℂ-n, nem a te `magnitudeSquared` definíciód.)   
- A `HashMap.contains`/„membership” használatod több helyen gyanúsan nem illeszkedik a Std/Mathlib-féle HashMap API-hoz: a dokumentáció szerint a `contains` kulcsot vár és Bool-t ad vissza, és a tagság (`a ∈ m`) is kulcs-szintű fogalom.  Emiatt például a `n.metadata.contains k v` alak (kulcs *és* érték) tipikusan nem az a művelet, ami ténylegesen létezik a Lean/Std HashMap-ben.[1]
- Több bizonyításod „számolós” jellegű (`ring`, `simp`, `field_simp`, stb.), de ezek csak akkor fognak működni, ha (1) a használt műveletek pontosan a megfelelő algebrai struktúrákhoz vannak példányosítva, és (2) a hivatkozott lemmák ténylegesen léteznek a definícióidhoz (nem csak „jó lenne, ha léteznének”). Ez a fájlrészlet alapján több ponton nem garantált.

## Hogyan lehet ebből tényleg formális verifikáció
- Ha a cél valóban kvantumos amplitúdók és normalizálás verifikálása, érdemes a Mathlib/Lean standard komplex számait (ℂ) és normáit használni, mert ott rengeteg lemma készen van (pl. `Complex.normSq` és a hozzá tartozó szorzási tulajdonságok).   
- A „memory safety / allocator” részhez tisztázd, milyen `HashMap`-et használsz (Std vs Mathlib wrapper), és pontosan milyen műveletei vannak (pl. `contains` kulcsra), és ehhez igazítsd a `wellFormed` predikátumot (például „minden meta-kulcshoz tartozó *érték* id tényleg allokált”, de ezt a mapből `find?`-al / `get?`-al szokás kiolvasni, nem „contains key value” formában).[1]
- A numerikus toleranciás invariáns (`abs (normSquared - 1) ≤ 1e-15`) matematikailag inkább „floating-point” gondolkodás; Lean/ℝ világban ez egy valós egyenlőtlenség, amit nagyon nehéz lesz érdemben bizonyítani „általánosan”, ha a normalizálásod ágazik és `clamp`-el. Ha formális bizonyítás a cél, sokszor tisztább cél az egzakt állítás (pl. `normSq = 1` a normalizált esetben, és külön a degenerált esetek kezelése).

Ha megírod, mi a pontos kérdésed a fájllal kapcsolatban (pl. „ezt le akarom fordítani és átmenjen”, vagy „az invariánsok legyenek tényleg bizonyítva”), akkor tudok javasolni egy konkrét, Mathlib-kompatibilis minimál verziót: ℂ-s amplitúdókkal, `normSq`-val és olyan tételekkel, amik *tényleg* végigmennek a Lean kernelében.
